title: “Some kneel in defeat.
paragraphs:
“Some kneel in defeat.
I kneel in preparation.” ⚔️

The mountain doesn’t move for those who wish —
it moves for those who train in silence before sunrise.
🕊️ ‘I don’t pray for easier battles; I train for bigger territory.’

“Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands for war and my fingers for battle.”
— Psalm 144 : 1
